ora·ïto — projects — Smoothie

Smoothie

Category Furniture
Brand Dunlopillo
Collection Dunlopillo
Year 2012

Smoothy is a young and current line corner offering a new convertible solution that is very easy to set up. Available in 160 cm wide for a mattress thickness of 14 cm, you have a very comfortable bed.

By creating a line of “new generation” seats for Dunlopillo, Ora-Ito wanted to invent a modular and easy-to-use collection: sofa, lounge, pouf, convertible devoid of any complex handling. From small to large interiors, models that suit all lifestyles.
